The codebase principle that a recurring/structural bug should be fixed by consolidation (extract one helper, close the whole CLASS) rather than patching the single failing site — the exact 'solidify, no spaghetti, consolidated in correct places' value Tom asked for.

The established config convention: runtime-tunable values via get_config(key, default) with documented defaults, framed as 'make parameters not decisions' (e.g. boost_rule=1.3) — the pattern the Part-2 BROADCAST_TTL_HOURS/DIRECTED_TTL_HOURS config-driven plan is modeled on.

The self-channel message/TTL architecture: expires_at was already part of the self_inflight/self_messages schema design, broadcast vs directed addressing semantics, and the distinct message types (Letter/Signal/Presence) — bearing on Tom's 'per-type TTL / more types / different scenarios' framing and the 'add expires_at via migration' decision.

The fact that a fresh worktree venv is runtime-only (no pytest), so tests on this branch require installing pytest via the bundled bin/uv — which the outcome did verbatim ('worktree venv is runtime-only, so I installed pytest==9.0.3 ... via the bundled bin/uv').
